summary_1line: Bhishma traces a sacred narrative lineage praising Narayana and explains why gods follow sacrificial action (Pravritti) while some sages pursue renunciation (Nivritti).

image_candidates.scene_text: Brahma, the gods, and great Rishis stand motionless with raised arms on the northern shore of the Ocean of Milk performing thousand‑year austerities.
The assembled gods perform a grand Vedic sacrifice while Brahma offers a sacred portion of oblations into the fire for Vishnu.
An unseen radiant Vishnu speaks from the heavens as the delighted gods and sages listen with hair standing on end.
